condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.note: Single primary trial per llm_learnability.prior_conflict_resistance_trials_per_language=1 in primary.json. Model followed the stated conflicting-keyword specification (treating toy `if` as a for-loop) rather than surface-familiar meaning, producing correct real Java, verified mechanically.
